address: 1457, Section 2, Yanping Road, Xiangshan District, Hsinchu City, Taiwan
bio: A firm favourite with professional drivers, this simple shop sells Taiwanese snacks and is depicted by warm, friendly service. The concise menu stars classic comfort food like braised pork rice, meatballs, sticky rice dumpling, and pork blood cake. Their eponymous gua bao is a steamed lotus leaf bun stuffed with flavourful, soft, yet bouncy pork belly slow-cooked for 3 hours. Pork meatball soup boasts springy textures and meaty umami.
